children: Hedge fund firm D.E. Shaw reported a 5.4% passive stake in Venture Global
as of September 8, according to its regulatory filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday.
Venture Global is the second-largest exporter of liquefied natural gas (LNG) in the United States, operating major export facilities along the U.S. Gulf Coast.
